typed_cross_task_outcome_memory.source: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery, arXiv:2603.08127v1
typed_cross_task_outcome_memory.primary_design: Three-agent autonomous-scientist framework with an ideation memory and a separate experimentation memory. Ideation memory records feasible top-ranked directions and unsuccessful directions discovered during validation; experimentation memory distills reusable data-processing/training strategies from full code-search trajectories and best implementations. Both are retrieved by cosine-similarity top-k on later tasks.
typed_cross_task_outcome_memory.interpretation: Provides direct science-domain evidence that cross-task distillation of execution outcomes/failures into a dedicated experimentation-memory channel can improve implementation reliability. It also supplies a concrete separation between strategic ideation memory and operational execution memory, strengthening the authority/role-typed memory line rather than arguing for one undifferentiated long-term memory.
typed_cross_task_outcome_memory.limits: The before/after execution comparison is not a randomized memory-versus-no-memory trial and the proposed-method stage gain is only 1.24 points. Retrieval is similarity-based and the reported design has no explicit contradiction/revocation lifecycle, so stale strategic memory can in principle be reintroduced. Evaluation is curated computational research rather than broad physical-lab science.

conversion_harness_implementation.source: Sibyl-AutoResearch: Autonomous Research Needs Self-Evolving Trial-and-Error Harnesses, Not Paper Generators, arXiv:2605.22343v1
conversion_harness_implementation.evidence: A file-backed scientist system makes trial-to-behavior and trial-to-harness-behavior conversions auditable. Retrospective audit reports eight high-confidence conversion events with median latency one iteration, maximum three; five naturally occurring failure classes including duplicate results, stale numbers and unsupported statistics were blocked, downgraded or routed to later repair.
conversion_harness_implementation.interpretation: Useful implementation evidence that negative trial outcomes can become machine-actionable later behavior rather than prose-only memory.
conversion_harness_implementation.limits: Authors explicitly make no comparative performance claim; not efficacy evidence.

lineage_dag_implementation.source: ScienceClaw + Infinite: Autonomous Agents Coordinating Distributed Discovery Through Emergent Artifact Exchange, arXiv:2603.14312v1
lineage_dag_implementation.evidence: Immutable typed artifacts with parent lineage form a DAG; unsatisfied information needs are broadcast, multi-parent synthesis is provenance-aware, and a mutation layer prunes conflicting/redundant workflows while persistent memory supports repeated cycles.
lineage_dag_implementation.interpretation: Independent implementation convergence toward immutable evidence authority plus mutable derived state, consistent with keeping raw evidence lineage separate from active summarized memory.
lineage_dag_implementation.limits: Four qualitative investigations; no matched memory or mutation-layer efficacy ablation.

cross_domain_restart_positive_control.source: Fail-Fast, Restart-Smart: Early Failure Prediction and Restart for SWE Agentic Tasks, arXiv:2608.03222v1
cross_domain_restart_positive_control.mechanism: A lightweight failure monitor interrupts a likely failing trajectory; a fresh same-policy rollout gets no prior prompt history but may inspect/apply/discard the interrupted repository diff as an optional overlay.
cross_domain_restart_positive_control.interpretation: Strengthens candidate_047's arbitration idea: selective carryover into a fresh branch can outperform both continued failing execution and fully cold restart under a controlled SWE setting.
cross_domain_restart_positive_control.limits: Software engineering, not autonomous science; does not compare full fresh-root science restart against continued scientific repair.
